chapter: Life on the road in the South
title: Counting the Lutcher siblings again
summary: Willard totals the named siblings against fifteen or sixteen children; others died at birth or before Nellie was born.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah, well I asked now because when I was listening to the first part of the tape you said that you were one of 15 or 16 children and I asked you the names of your brothers and sisters and I counted and we got 10 names. Now, you make 11, so there's four more. I was just trying to --
Well, some of them died you know.
I don't even remember the ones that died. But --
We got Florida, Bubba or Isaac, Jr., Joe, Charlie, James, Florence, Eugenia, Vida, Margie and Bennie.
And that was as far as we got.
Those were my mother's -- the others died, the other children died, you know.
At birth or -- I think we had one brother that I do remember, was named David. I remember his name. But the other children died before I was born. My mother's other
